Resolves #20088

Strips the leading `blog/` record-ID prefix when constructing and resolving Portal blog routes across `collectBlogRoutes()` (`buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs`), `Portal.view.news.blog.MainContainerController` (`navigateTo` and `onRouteItem`), and `Portal.view.news.blog.Component#resolveContentId`, eliminating the doubled `/news/blog/blog/<slug>` URLs in `sitemap.xml`, `content-routes.json`, `TreeList` links, and sibling blog markdown links while preserving `blog/<slug>` record IDs in `apps/portal/resources/data/blog.json` so relative links inside `learn/blog/*.md` retain their 1-folder depth inside `learn/`.

Change class: `restoration` (`fix`). `agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline check-file-sizes, check-relative-links, lint-staged, and pre-push guards ran`.

Evidence: L2 (Playwright unit specs for `generate.mjs`, `BlogLinks`, and `MainContainerController` + live `collectBlogRoutes()` CLI verification on `apps/portal/resources/data/blog.json`) → L2 required (all 3 ACs of `#20088` are in-repo route generation, link rewriting, and controller resolution contracts).

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/seo/Generate.spec.mjs` (`a post becomes a /news/blog/<slug> route dated by its markdown file`) |
| AC-2 | `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/seo/Generate.spec.mjs` (`routes, sitemap, and llms.txt include every native blog post from blog.json`) + CLI run against live `apps/portal/resources/data/blog.json` (`20` `/news/blog/<slug>` routes, `0` `/news/blog/blog/<slug>` routes) |
| AC-3 | `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/news/blog/MainContainerController.spec.mjs` (`navigateTo`, `onRouteItem` with `#fragment` + `tree.routePrefix = '/news'`, and legacy `/news/blog/blog/<slug>` fallback) + `test/playwright/unit/app/content/BlogLinks.spec.mjs` |

## Deltas from ticket
- Updated `#20088`'s Contract Ledger Matrix in place to name `collectBlogRoutes()` (the exported generator function in `buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs`) and added rows for `Portal.view.news.blog.MainContainerController` and `Portal.view.news.blog.Component#resolveContentId`, which also prepended `news/blog` onto `blog/<slug>` record IDs.
- Kept backward-compatible resolution for legacy `/news/blog/blog/<slug>` deep links in `MainContainerController#onRouteItem`.

## Test Evidence

### `@neo-opus-grace` (APPROVED) reviewed on 2026-10-24T23:45:30Z

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** contained — one route convention (`blog/<slug>` record ids served at `/news/blog/<slug>`) fixed in its three producers, with tests; no new abstraction or consumed contract.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** The claim: every internal blog URL doubled its prefix (`/news/blog/blog/<slug>`) because record ids carry `blog/` for relative-link depth and three producers prepended `/news/blog/` anyway. Verified at `3c474cb174`:
- **Red-first.** With `dev`'s three sources under the PR's specs, 6 tests fail: controller routing ×2, link rewriting ×2, generator ×2. At the head all 22 pass. CI is 51 pass, 1 skipped.
- **Real browser.** I served the portal and opened the routes in headless Chromium. At the head, `#/news/blog/where-an-agent-institution-sits` renders the post (its h1 and 9.6k characters). On `dev`'s sources the same URL renders no post. The legacy `#/news/blog/blog/<slug>` still renders at the head through the `{*itemId}` route, so links already out in the world keep working.
- **What I looked for.** `TreeList` builds a route only for leaf clicks. Every leaf in `blog.json` carries `blog/`, and the only two records without it are the year folders. So `routePrefix = '/news'` yields `/news/blog/<slug>` for every clickable item today.

**Findings:** none required.
- Non-blocking: the new controller spec replaces the global `Neo.Main` and never restores it. Playwright reuses a worker across files, so later specs in that worker see the stub. It is harmless today, since setup installs only `setRoute`, but the house pattern saves and restores (`DockWorkspace.spec.mjs:4717–4743`). Simpler still: spy on the `Neo.Main.setRoute` that setup already provides.
- Non-blocking: `routePrefix = '/news'` now depends on every leaf id starting with `blog/`. A future leaf without it would route into `/news/<id>`, another section's namespace. A one-line assertion over `blog.json` leaves would pin that.
- Non-blocking: AC-2's `llms.txt` half needed no change. `llms.txt` lists posts by raw markdown URL, so it never carried the doubled route; the body could say so.
